title: The Invisible Survivor
hook: The toughest animal on Earth is one you cannot even see.
script: The toughest animal on Earth is one you cannot even see. This eight-legged tardigrade lives in your backyard, but it hides a terrifying power. What if you left one in the open vacuum of space? It would survive by entering cryptobiosis, shrugging off radiation 1,000 times what would kill you. They can even withstand pressures six times deeper than the bottom of the Mariana Trench. To do this, they replace their internal water with a glass-like sugar called trehalose. They pull in their legs and dry into a shriveled husk called a tun. In this state, they can survive temperatures just one degree above absolute zero. But when they are hydrated, a simple mite can eat them in seconds. It is a strange trade for the toughest animal on Earth.

The science of cryptobiosis is unsettling.
